title: Say Yes
feel: Strum: B B D DU B B D DU (B = bass note)

sections.name: Verse
sections.bars: G G/F# | Em D | C Em7/B | A

sections.name: Instrumental turn
sections.bars: C D | Em | G A | C/G
sections.note: After two passes of the verse; then the verse again.

sections.name: Bridge
sections.bars: G G/D# | G/E G/F | G/E G/D | C | G G/D# | G/E G/F | G/E G/D | A
sections.note: Then a riff (G F Em, Em C).

why: A **chromatic line cliché in the bass** (D–D♯–E–F–E–D under G) — aug → 6 → 7 — and the **II-major chord** (A in G = V/V).
hard_change: **G/F → G/E → G/D**: one finger walks down the 4th string while the G on top keeps ringing.
theory: In G shapes: verse I–(V6)–vi–V–IV–vi–II (V/V, a Lydian flash). Bridge: I – I+ – I6 – I7 – I6 – I.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: the bridge bass line D–D♯–E–F–E–D.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 54 bpm), the bass-strum pattern.
With the record, tuned down a whole step (or in standard tuning it plays in G).
tips: Outro = the verse, holding the A.
